svg.title: ttt-minibatch
svg.desc: Mini-batch TTT over a toy 32-token sequence. With b = 1 every gradient uses the latest W: 32 sequential steps (online GD). With b = 8 gradients inside a batch share the batch-start W: 4 sequential steps. With b = T one step, which with linear f, eta = 1/2 and W0 = 0 equals linear attention. The paper uses b = 16. Reported 125M ablation (Table 1): perplexity 15.91 for linear attention falls to 11.09; mini-batch TTT is the largest single gain, -1.70.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: Wt = Wt-1 − ηt ∇ℓ(Wt′ ; xt ), t′ = t − (t mod b)
■ W at batch start (purple chain = sequential dependency) · ▬ tokens whose gradients run as one matmul
Reported ablation, 125M on the Pile (T = 2048), perplexity ↓
